items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: He was Professor Snead. And he played all the string instruments. He started me out on the ukulele.

ctx.x: Nashville. What was music like in Nashville when you grew up?

Well there was a lot of jazz around the schools you know, and they had some nice bands — Fisk University, a big band you know? And I started, I was around most of the good musicians that came, and so I met a guy that was going to Fisk. He was Professor Snead. And he played all the string instruments. He started me out on the ukulele. I started out on the ukulele. I was about ten years old. And I got to be pretty famous in and around town.
